audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed as Elihu's final storm speech: trembling heart, thunder/voice, snow/rain, sealed human hand, animals, cloud balance, heat/wind, human inability to arrange speech, and awe before Shaddai. Serves as transition into the whirlwind.

verses.restored: At this also my heart trembles and leaps from its place.

familiar.text: At this also my heart trembleth, and is moved out of his place.

modern.text: “At this my heart also pounds and leaps from its place.

original.text: אַף לְ֭זֹאת יֶחֱרַ֣ד לִבִּ֑י וְ֝יִתַּ֗ר מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ

verses.restored: Listen, listen to the roar of his voice and the rumbling that goes out from his mouth.

familiar.text: Hear attentively the noise of his voice, and the sound that goeth out of his mouth.

modern.text: Listen closely to the thunder of His voice and the rumbling that comes from His mouth.

original.text: שִׁמְע֤וּ שָׁמ֣וֹעַ בְּרֹ֣גֶז קֹל֑וֹ וְ֝הֶ֗גֶה מִפִּ֥יו יֵצֵֽא

verses.restored: Under all the heavens he lets it loose, and his lightning to the corners of the earth.

familiar.text: He directeth it under the whole heaven, and his lightning unto the ends of the earth.

modern.text: He unleashes His lightning beneath the whole sky and sends it to the ends of the earth.

original.text: תַּֽחַת כָּל הַשָּׁמַ֥יִם יִשְׁרֵ֑הוּ וְ֝אוֹר֗וֹ עַל כַּנְפ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: After it a voice roars; he thunders with his majestic voice, and he does not hold them back when his voice is heard.

familiar.text: After it a voice roareth: he thundereth with the voice of his excellency; and he will not stay them when his voice is heard.

modern.text: Then there comes a roaring sound; He thunders with His majestic voice. He does not restrain the lightning when His voice resounds.

original.text: אַחֲרָ֤יו יִשְׁאַג ק֗וֹל יַ֭רְעֵם בְּק֣וֹל גְּאוֹנ֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א יְ֝עַקְּבֵ֗ם כִּֽי יִשָּׁמַ֥ע קוֹלֽוֹ

verses.restored: The Divine thunders with his voice wondrously, doing great things that we do not know.

familiar.text: God thundereth marvellously with his voice; great things doeth he, which we cannot comprehend.

modern.text: God thunders wondrously with His voice; He does great things we cannot comprehend.

original.text: יַרְעֵ֤ם אֵ֣ל בְּ֭קוֹלוֹ נִפְלָא֑וֹת עֹשֶׂ֥ה גְ֝דֹל֗וֹת וְלֹ֣א נֵדָֽע

verses.restored: For to the snow he says, Fall on the earth, and to the shower of rain and the heavy shower of his strength.

familiar.text: For he saith to the snow, Be thou on the earth; likewise to the small rain, and to the great rain of his strength.

modern.text: For He says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ and to the gentle rain, ‘Pour out a mighty downpour.’

original.text: כִּ֤י לַשֶּׁ֨לַג יֹאמַ֗ר הֱוֵ֫א אָ֥רֶץ וְגֶ֥שֶׁם מָטָ֑ר וְ֝גֶ֗שֶׁם מִטְר֥וֹת עֻזּֽוֹ

verses.restored: He seals the hand of every human, so that all people may know his work.

familiar.text: He sealeth up the hand of every man; that all men may know his work.

modern.text: He seals up the hand of every man, so that all men may know His work.

original.text: בְּיַד כָּל אָדָ֥ם יַחְתּ֑וֹם לָ֝דַ֗עַת כָּל אַנְשֵׁ֥י מַעֲשֵֽׂהוּ

verses.restored: The beast goes into its lair and remains in its dens.

familiar.text: Then the beasts go into dens, and remain in their places.

modern.text: The wild animals enter their lairs; they settle down in their dens.

original.text: וַתָּבֹ֣א חַיָּ֣ה בְמוֹ אָ֑רֶב וּבִמְע֖וֹנֹתֶ֣יהָ תִשְׁכֹּֽן

verses.restored: From the chamber comes the storm, and cold from the scattering winds.

familiar.text: Out of the south cometh the whirlwind: and cold out of the north.

modern.text: The tempest comes from its chamber, and the cold from the driving north winds.

original.text: מִן הַ֭חֶדֶר תָּב֣וֹא סוּפָ֑ה וּֽמִמְּזָרִ֥ים קָרָֽה

verses.restored: By the breath of the Divine ice is given, and the breadth of waters is constrained.

familiar.text: By the breath of God frost is given: and the breadth of the waters is straitened.

modern.text: By the breath of God the ice is formed and the watery expanses are frozen.

original.text: מִנִּשְׁמַת אֵ֥ל יִתֶּן קָ֑רַח וְרֹ֖חַב מַ֣יִם בְּמוּצָֽק

verses.restored: Indeed, he loads the thick cloud with moisture; he scatters the cloud of his lightning.

familiar.text: Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud: he scattereth his bright cloud:

modern.text: He loads the clouds with moisture; He scatters His lightning through them.

original.text: אַף בְּ֭רִי יַטְרִ֣יחַ עָ֑ב יָ֝פִ֗יץ עֲנַ֣ן אוֹרֽוֹ

verses.restored: It turns around by his guidance, to do all that he commands upon the face of the inhabited earth.

familiar.text: And it is turned round about by his counsels: that they may do whatsoever he commandeth them upon the face of the world in the earth.

modern.text: They swirl about, whirling at His direction, accomplishing all that He commands over the face of all the earth.

original.text: וְה֤וּא מְסִבּ֨וֹת מִתְהַפֵּ֣ךְ בתחבולתו לְפָעֳלָ֑ם כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְצַוֵּ֓ם עַל פְּנֵ֖י תֵבֵ֣ל אָֽרְצָה

verses.restored: Whether for rod, or for his land, or for covenant-kindness, he causes it to happen.

familiar.text: He causeth it to come, whether for correction, or for his land, or for mercy.

modern.text: Whether for punishment or for His land, He accomplishes this in His loving devotion.

original.text: אִם לְשֵׁ֥בֶט אִם לְאַרְצ֑וֹ אִם לְ֝חֶ֗סֶד יַמְצִאֵֽהוּ

verses.restored: Give ear to this, Job; stand still and consider the wonders of the Divine.

familiar.text: Hearken unto this, O Job: stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

modern.text: Listen to this, O Job; stand still and consider the wonders of God.

original.text: הַאֲזִ֣ינָה זֹּ֣את אִיּ֑וֹב עֲ֝מֹ֗ד וְהִתְבּוֹנֵ֤ן נִפְלְא֬וֹת אֵֽל

verses.restored: Do you know how the Divine lays command upon them and makes the light of his cloud shine?

familiar.text: Dost thou know when God disposed them, and caused the light of his cloud to shine?

modern.text: Do you know how God dispatches the clouds or makes the lightning flash?

original.text: הֲ֭תֵדַע בְּשׂוּם אֱל֣וֹהַּ עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝הוֹפִ֗יעַ א֣וֹר עֲנָנֽוֹ

verses.restored: Do you know the balancings of the clouds, the wonders of one complete in knowledge?

familiar.text: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him which is perfect in knowledge?

modern.text: Do you understand how the clouds float, those wonders of Him who is perfect in knowledge?

original.text: הֲ֭תֵדַע עַל מִפְלְשֵׂי עָ֑ב מִ֝פְלְא֗וֹת תְּמִ֣ים דֵּעִֽים

verses.restored: You whose garments are hot when the earth is still because of the south wind,

familiar.text: How thy garments are warm, when he quieteth the earth by the south wind?

modern.text: You whose clothes get hot when the land lies hushed under the south wind,

original.text: אֲשֶׁר בְּגָדֶ֥יךָ חַמִּ֑ים בְּהַשְׁקִ֥ט אֶ֝֗רֶץ מִדָּרֽוֹם

verses.restored: can you, with him, spread out the skies, strong as a cast metal mirror?

familiar.text: Hast thou with him spread out the sky, which is strong, and as a molten looking glass?

modern.text: can you, like Him, spread out the skies to reflect the heat like a mirror of bronze?

original.text: תַּרְקִ֣יעַ עִ֭מּוֹ לִשְׁחָקִ֑ים חֲ֝זָקִ֗ים כִּרְאִ֥י מוּצָֽק

verses.restored: Make known to us what we should say to him; we cannot arrange words because of darkness.

familiar.text: Teach us what we shall say unto him; for we cannot order our speech by reason of darkness.

modern.text: Teach us what we should say to Him; we cannot draw up our case when our faces are in darkness.

original.text: ה֭וֹדִיעֵנוּ מַה נֹּ֣אמַר ל֑וֹ לֹ֥א נַ֝עֲרֹ֗ךְ מִפְּנֵי חֹֽשֶׁךְ

verses.restored: Should it be told him that I would speak? If a man said so, surely he would be swallowed up.

familiar.text: Shall it be told him that I speak? if a man speak, surely he shall be swallowed up.

modern.text: Should He be told that I want to speak? Would a man ask to be swallowed up ?

original.text: הַֽיְסֻפַּר ל֭וֹ כִּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר אִֽם אָ֥מַר אִ֝֗ישׁ כִּ֣י יְבֻלָּֽע

verses.restored: Now people do not see the light, bright as it is in the skies, when wind passes and clears them.

familiar.text: And now men see not the bright light which is in the clouds: but the wind passeth, and cleanseth them.

modern.text: Now no one can gaze at the sun when it is bright in the skies after the wind has swept them clean.

original.text: וְעַתָּ֤ה לֹ֘א רָ֤אוּ א֗וֹר בָּהִ֣יר ה֭וּא בַּשְּׁחָקִ֑ים וְר֥וּחַ עָ֝בְרָ֗ה וַֽתְּטַהֲרֵֽם

verses.restored: From the north comes gold-like brightness; around the Divine is fearsome majesty.

familiar.text: Fair weather cometh out of the north: with God is terrible majesty.

modern.text: Out of the north He comes in golden splendor; awesome majesty surrounds Him.

original.text: מִ֭צָּפוֹן זָהָ֣ב יֶֽאֱתֶ֑ה עַל אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ נ֣וֹרָא הֽוֹד

verses.restored: Shaddai, we cannot find him out; he is great in power and justice, and abundant in righteousness; he does not oppress.

familiar.text: Touching the Almighty, we cannot find him out: he is excellent in power, and in judgment, and in plenty of justice: he will not afflict.

modern.text: The Almighty is beyond our reach; He is exalted in power! In His justice and great righteousness He does not oppress.

original.text: שַׁדַּ֣י לֹֽא מְ֭צָאנֻהוּ שַׂגִּיא כֹ֑חַ וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט וְרֹב צְ֝דָקָ֗ה לֹ֣א יְעַנֶּֽה

verses.restored: Therefore people fear him; he does not regard any who are wise in heart.

familiar.text: Men do therefore fear him: he respecteth not any that are wise of heart.

modern.text: Therefore, men fear Him, for He is not partial to the wise in heart.”

original.text: לָ֭כֵן יְרֵא֣וּהוּ אֲנָשִׁ֑ים לֹֽא יִ֝רְאֶ֗ה כָּל חַכְמֵי לֵֽב
